title: ISERROR ( DIVIDE ( 1, 0 ) ) is FALSE: DIVIDE returns BLANK, which is not an error

source.quote: DIVIDE returns BLANK instead, which is not an error
source.supports: the page's example shows FALSE for ISERROR ( DIVIDE ( 1, 0 ) )

notes: DAX Guide also says ISERROR cannot catch every runtime error, depending on the execution plan. The page's example shows TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE for 1 / 0, -1 / 0, 0 / 0, DIVIDE ( 1, 0 ), DIVIDE ( 0, 0 ).
